commands:
set -u
MAC=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work
WT=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/macbook-trackpad-zoom
printf 'MAC_BRANCH=%s\n' "$(git -C "$MAC" branch --show-current 2>&1)"
printf 'MAC_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git -C "$MAC" rev-parse HEAD 2>&1)"
printf 'MAC_DIRTY_START\n'
git -C "$MAC" status --short --branch 2>&1

printf 'MAC_WORKTREE_STATUS_BEGIN\n'
git -C "$WT" status --short --branch 2>&1
printf 'MAC_WORKTREE_STATUS_END\n'
git -C "$MAC" worktree list --porcelain
printf 'KEY_EXISTS=%s\n' "$(test -r /Users/michal/.ssh/id_ed25519 && echo yes || echo no)"
printf 'IS_ANCESTOR='
git -C "$MAC" merge-base --is-ancestor 524c40a218ad59d985a133efc542e99f51f5912a d21400207c121eb3169647978072ee18a99269d1 && echo yes || echo no
